title: Has anyone else’s Mallworld changed over the last month or so?
content: Over the last 4-5 weeks my dream landscape has felt…different. The same types of places appear (locker room/bathroom, college campus, etc.) but they don’t have quite the same look or feel to them, and they are just CROWDED with people. Usually there are always other people around in my dreams but everywhere is incredibly busy now. I also haven’t been able to remember the “plots” of my dreams as well, just the locations and the large amounts of people. I’m just curious if any fellow visitors have noticed changes recently, or did you have a time in your life where your landscape shifted? And if so, what is different?
